name: local-llm-sim Dev Container
postCreateCommand: python3 -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && pip install -e '.[dev]' && chmod +x scripts/dev.sh
postStartCommand:
echo '
=== local-llm-sim Dev Environment ===

1. Set your API key:
   export OPENROUTER_API_KEY="sk-or-..."
   (or create .env file with OPENROUTER_API_KEY=sk-or-...)

2. Start services:
   source .venv/bin/activate
   ./scripts/dev.sh start-all

3. Access:
   - Open WebUI: http://localhost:3000
   - API: http://localhost:11434
'
